{"success":true,"scripts":[{"id":"d1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","user_id":"__OWNER__","team_id":null,"name":"LIFE","body":"Hi (client), this is (agent) reaching out about the life coverage you looked into. Did I catch you at an okay time?

Perfect, this only takes a couple of minutes. Most people I talk to want two things: their family taken care of, and a payment that actually fits the budget. Does that sound about right for you?

Who would you want this coverage to protect, if something happened tomorrow?

That makes sense. And roughly how much would you want to leave them: enough for final expenses, or enough to cover the mortgage and bills too?

Got it. I work with several carriers, so my job is to shop this for you instead of pushing one company. A few quick health questions will tell us what you qualify for, and many of these plans have no medical exam.

Have you used any tobacco in the last twelve months? Any major health changes in the last few years?

Thanks for being straight with me. Based on that, let me show you two options, and you tell me which one feels comfortable. If neither one fits, that's okay, we just won't move forward.","sort_order":0,"created_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","updated_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","is_team":false},{"id":"d1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","user_id":"__OWNER__","team_id":null,"name":"HEALTH","body":"Hi (client), this is (agent), you requested help finding a health plan. Is now a good time?

Great. So I can point you in the right direction, are you covered right now, or are you looking to get coverage started?

What made you start looking: the price, the deductible, or a doctor who isn't in your network?

That's the most common one I hear. Let me ask you a few things so I'm not wasting your time.

Who needs to be covered, just you or the family too? What's your zip code? And are there any doctors or prescriptions you absolutely need to keep?

Perfect. What are you paying a month now, and what would feel like a comfortable number?

Okay. I'm going to compare what's available in your area and walk you through what each plan really covers: the deductible, the copays, and the most you could pay in a year, so nothing surprises you later.

Here are the two that fit best. Which one is closer to what you had in mind?","sort_order":1,"created_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","updated_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","is_team":false},{"id":"d1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003","user_id":"__OWNER__","team_id":null,"name":"REAL ESTATE","body":"Hi (client), this is (agent), I saw you were curious what your home might be worth. Did I catch you at a bad time?

Great, I'll be quick. Homes around you have been moving, so I can get you a real number today instead of an online guess.

What got you curious about the value: are you thinking about selling, refinancing, or just keeping an eye on it?

Makes sense. If you did decide to move, where would you be headed next, and is there a timeline you have in mind?

Have you made any updates since you bought it? A new roof, kitchen, or bathrooms can change the number quite a bit.

Thanks, that helps. Here's what I'd suggest: I'll put together a short report with what similar homes nearby actually sold for, and what you could expect to walk away with after costs.

There's no obligation. It just gives you real numbers to make a decision with.

I can go over it with you in about ten minutes. Does later today or tomorrow morning work better?","sort_order":2,"created_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","updated_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","is_team":false},{"id":"d1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004","user_id":"__OWNER__","team_id":null,"name":"SOLAR","body":"Hi (client), this is (agent), did I catch you at an okay time?

Great. You asked about cutting your power bill with solar, so I wanted to get you a quick free estimate. It only takes a couple of minutes.

First, do you own the home? And roughly what's your electric bill in a typical month, and in the summer?

Wow, okay. Is that bill getting higher each year, or has it stayed about the same?

How's your roof: mostly open sun, or a lot of shade from trees? And do you know about how old it is?

Perfect. Here's how this works. We look at your actual usage and your roof, and we work out whether solar would really save you money. If the numbers don't work for your home, I'll tell you that, and you've lost nothing.

If they do work, you'll see what the system costs, what you'd pay each month, and how that compares with your bill today, side by side.

One of our specialists can walk you through it. Would you want your spouse or anyone else on that call? What day works best for you both?","sort_order":3,"created_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","updated_at":"2026-11-06T02:09:30.247Z","is_team":false}]}

scripts.name: LIFE
scripts.body:
Hi (client), this is (agent) reaching out about the life coverage you looked into. Did I catch you at an okay time?

Perfect, this only takes a couple of minutes. Most people I talk to want two things: their family taken care of, and a payment that actually fits the budget. Does that sound about right for you?

Who would you want this coverage to protect, if something happened tomorrow?

That makes sense. And roughly how much would you want to leave them: enough for final expenses, or enough to cover the mortgage and bills too?

Got it. I work with several carriers, so my job is to shop this for you instead of pushing one company. A few quick health questions will tell us what you qualify for, and many of these plans have no medical exam.

Have you used any tobacco in the last twelve months? Any major health changes in the last few years?

Thanks for being straight with me. Based on that, let me show you two options, and you tell me which one feels comfortable. If neither one fits, that's okay, we just won't move forward.

scripts.name: HEALTH
scripts.body:
Hi (client), this is (agent), you requested help finding a health plan. Is now a good time?

Great. So I can point you in the right direction, are you covered right now, or are you looking to get coverage started?

What made you start looking: the price, the deductible, or a doctor who isn't in your network?

That's the most common one I hear. Let me ask you a few things so I'm not wasting your time.

Who needs to be covered, just you or the family too? What's your zip code? And are there any doctors or prescriptions you absolutely need to keep?

Perfect. What are you paying a month now, and what would feel like a comfortable number?

Okay. I'm going to compare what's available in your area and walk you through what each plan really covers: the deductible, the copays, and the most you could pay in a year, so nothing surprises you later.

Here are the two that fit best. Which one is closer to what you had in mind?

scripts.name: REAL ESTATE
scripts.body:
Hi (client), this is (agent), I saw you were curious what your home might be worth. Did I catch you at a bad time?

Great, I'll be quick. Homes around you have been moving, so I can get you a real number today instead of an online guess.

What got you curious about the value: are you thinking about selling, refinancing, or just keeping an eye on it?

Makes sense. If you did decide to move, where would you be headed next, and is there a timeline you have in mind?

Have you made any updates since you bought it? A new roof, kitchen, or bathrooms can change the number quite a bit.

Thanks, that helps. Here's what I'd suggest: I'll put together a short report with what similar homes nearby actually sold for, and what you could expect to walk away with after costs.
